name: Command: Bonefreeze ends once several hits below its damage cap add up past it (#12435)
contract: Command: Bonefreeze 504489 makes a Skeletal Mage 50075 cast Bonefreeze 504845 (8 yd area at the target, 40 s,
two MOD_ROOT effects). Since Necromancer ADR 0082 it breaks on the stock damage cap: each root effect gets
BaseHealth(level 60, class 1, expansion 2) / 4.75 = int32(4979 / 4.75) = 1048, the magic-negative taken proc
flag lets Lichfrost proc it, and HandleBreakableCCAuraProc subtracts every hit from the remaining amount and
removes the freeze at 0, so damage accumulates. A Necromancer raises one Skeletal Mage, Commands the freeze
on the primary dummy and sets Undead: Pacify 500983 right after the Command (precondition fixture: the Mage's
damage is blocked, so only Lichfrost erodes the cap; owned_creature_damage_count 50075 must stay 0). A control
dummy 4 yd from the primary is inside the freeze and never hit. Fixtures: Reg's Test Aura 984954 (no spell
crit), beeg spellpen 823764 (no partial resist), spell hit rating 10000 (no miss) and QA Test 10000% Increased
Frost Damage 13055 with its amount set to +20. Lichfrost 501978 rolls 569 to 597 (Effect[0] 568 + 1d29) at
Frost spell power 0, so one hit deals about 682 to 716: at least 332 below the cap, and two hits deal at least
1364: at least 316 above it. The bands asserted on the dummy's Lichfrost damage (670 to 730 for one hit,
1340 to 1460 for two) keep both margins above 290. After the first Lichfrost the primary is still frozen; after
the second, with each hit below the cap and their sum above it, the freeze is gone, while the control dummy
stays frozen, so the freeze ended on damage and not on its duration.
Both root effects are read as aura_amount: 1048 before any damage and 318 to 378 (the cap minus the 670 to 730
band) after the first hit, so a wrong initial cap or a wrong debit fails apart from the freeze reads.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Undead: Pacify keeps the Mage's damage off
SETUP: the primary dummy is frozen
SETUP: the control dummy is frozen
Root effect 0 starts with the full 1048 damage cap
Root effect 1 starts with the full 1048 damage cap
First Lichfrost: 2.5 s cast and flight
SETUP: one Lichfrost hit landed on the primary dummy
SETUP: the first hit stays well below the 1048 cap
One hit below the cap leaves the freeze on
Root effect 0 keeps the cap minus the first hit
Root effect 1 keeps the cap minus the first hit
Second Lichfrost: 2.5 s cast and flight
SETUP: a second Lichfrost hit landed on the primary dummy
SETUP: the two hits add up well above the 1048 cap
SETUP: the Skeletal Mage dealt no damage
Two hits below the cap whose sum passes it end the freeze
CONTROL: the undamaged dummy is still frozen
